title: Abyssals v0.90.33 — Nursery & Stewardship
notes: Batch stewardship completes multiple escalating-cost lessons with exact donor thresholds and leaves surplus partners untouched. Bulk ordinary rehoming, visible selection controls, confirmation and held-item returns. Marasen Grand Exchange 5F sells Family Seals (20,000), Heirloom Charm (500,000), Prodigy Feed (35,000), Inheritance Thread (15,000) and Brooding Warmer (200,000). Charm stacks additively with Feed or Thread; pairing previews actual odds, species and consumed supplies. Warmer reduces new eggs to 384 steps. Preserves existing eggs, offspring, saves, earned stats, quests, permanent deaths and original APK signing. PWA source/offline version updated.
